params.body:
Four list issues Ilse reported on 2026-09-17, one PR. Reporter: Ilse (dealer team). Decision on the first point: Shane, 2026-09-17 (`klant:beslissingen#lijsten-2026-09-17`).

## 1. Filters survive a detour to a vehicle (own fleet and shared stock)

Filter, open a vehicle, come back: the whole list, filter gone. PR 472 decided that filters are not remembered between visits, and that stands. Shane's decision reconciles the two: **a detour to a vehicle is not a new visit**. The browser's back button and the "overzicht" link on the vehicle restore the filters, the sort and the number of rows loaded, and the list scrolls back to the row that was clicked. The menu, the dashboard and the address bar still open a clean list.

How: `App\Livewire\Concerns\ContinuesList` (used by `OwnStockList` and `StocklistBrowser`). Every render of a list gets an id (`listId`) and mirrors its filter, sort and page size in the session under that id after every request (`dehydrate`). When a vehicle is opened, `ui-return.js` marks the list's own address with `?from=vehicle&list=<id>` through `history.replaceState`, so the back button reloads a marked address; the detail's back link follows the Referer (`Search::backToList`) and carries the same mark. `Search::continuesList` reads the mark as a continuation (next to `page`, `sortby`, `paginate` from PR 472) and `mount` restores that render, rows included, in the first response (capped at 200 like `restorePerPage`).

Why an id and not "the last render": while building this, the classic edit page turned out to load `/relations_modal` in a hidden iframe; for a user without that right the Access middleware redirects to home, which is the own fleet list for a module_1 dealer, and that invisible render wiped the mirror of the list on screen. With the id, a handful of renders live side by side (5, oldest out first) and the way back names its own.

## 2 and 3. Sort with a filter, brand sort orders models too

"Merk (A-Z)" on a Citroën filter came out "sorted by date". The order was not dropped anywhere: `getOwnStockList` sorted on `manufacturers.name` alone, and with a brand filter every row shares that value, so MySQL returned them in table order (effectively by id, which reads as by date). Brand now sorts brand, then model (Berlingo, C3, C3 Aircross, C4), then newest first. One change in `VehicleRepository::getOwnStockList`. The shared stock has no alphabetical sort option, so nothing to change there.

## 4. "Paneel openhouden"

A switch in the filter panel of the own fleet (`ui-switch`, on the "Meer filters" line), remembered per user on every device, default closed. Stored in a new nullable JSON column `users.preferences` with `User::preference()` / `User::rememberPreference()` (the `settings` table has an unused `user_id` column but a `SettingObserver` reacts to it, so a plain column on the user is the safer home). The switch is not a filter: the loaded rows stay. Copy `ownstock.keep_filter_panel_open` in nl/fr/en/de.

## 5. Photo hover preview

The row already carried the hook (`data-overview-preview` with the medium size from `VehicleImageService::urlVoor`); the jQuery that showed it left with the classic `ownstock/index.blade.php` on 2026-08-04. `resources/js/photo-preview.js` (global `uiPreview`, attached once from the list root, delegated so Livewire may re-render the rows) shows the photo next to the pointer, loads the `md` size only on hover, and does nothing on a device that cannot hover (`(hover: none)`). Styled by the existing `.ownstock-overview-preview` rule in `resources/sass/_index_ownstock.scss`; no library.

**Hot file touched: `resources/views/ownstock/_wagen_rij.blade.php`, one token.** The hook was `{{ e($hoverImg) }}`, escaped twice, so the browser read `&` inside the signed bucket url's query string and the image never loaded. Now `{{ $hoverImg }}`. Please sequence merges on that file accordingly.

## Rules and tests

- P1-1.6 (brand then model), P1-1.18 (the exception named), new P1-1.19 (detour), P1-1.20 (panel preference), P1-1.21 (hover preview); S5-1.1 and S5-1.18 (shared stock); decision `klant:beslissingen#lijsten-2026-09-17`.
- New: `OwnStockListContinuationTest` (detour restores; fresh visit clean; a render in between does not wipe; cap 200; back link follows the Referer; brand-then-model order under a filter, all, descending; panel preference per user; hover hook and single escaping), `StocklistBrowserContinuationTest` (detour restores; fresh visit clean; seller deep link still works), `SearchContinuationTest` (unit, the helper).
- Run green locally on a schema database: `StocklistBrowser*`, `OwnStockList*`, `OwnStockRow*`, `OwnStockHeader*`, `SearchContinuation*`, `StocklistDetail*`, `StocklistCount*`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest`, `RulesSourcesTest`, `RulesDocsBuildTest`, `LanguageParityTest`, `AlpineExpressionTest`, `HandlerWiringTest`, `CompiledViewsTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest`, `BuildContractTest` (98 tests, 1 pre-existing incomplete) and `SmokeTest` filtered on stocklist/ownvehicle (53 tests).
- Verified in the browser (Playwright, own fleet): filter Citroën + Merk (A-Z) gives Berlingo, C3, C3 Aircross, C4; back button and "overzicht" bring the same four back at `?from=vehicle&list=…`; the address bar gives the full list; the hover preview shows the photo; the switch keeps the panel open on the next visit.

Migration: `2026_09_17_120000_add_preferences_to_users.php` (nullable column, no data change); Forge runs `migrate --force` on deploy.
params.title: Lists: filters survive a detour to a vehicle, sort applies with a filter, brand sort orders models too, filter panel can stay open, photo hover preview is back
